answer: A farm that parks aliases between attacks hence finds them worthless when it returns to them. The glacier decay curve is applied at each close, tide records the drop, and crystal recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 2 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The attacker spends 255 dollars and 15 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
